professionalSummary: Experienced payments operations analyst with a proven track record of clearing SWIFT exceptions, reconciling nostro accounts, preparing daily cut‑off reports, repairing MT103/MT202 messages, and supporting weekday month‑end processing.
experienceHighlights: Cleared approximately 60 SWIFT payment exceptions daily within internal service‑level times at Harrowgate Building Society.
Reconciled four nostro accounts each morning using SmartStream TLM, escalating unmatched items above £10,000 before 11:00.
Prepared and submitted daily cut‑off reports to the payments operations manager, detailing payments sent, held, and queued for the next value date.
Read and repaired MT103 customer transfers and MT202 bank‑to‑bank transfers, correcting beneficiary and intermediary details against standing settlement instructions.
Supported weekday month‑end processing for retail payments queues.
projectsAndWorkSamples: An anonymised daily cut‑off report sample showing counts of payments sent and held, items queued for the next value date, and the day's exceptions log.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume, work sample, and reference notes establish the candidate’s experience with SWIFT exception handling, nostro reconciliation, daily cut‑off reporting, MT103/MT202 repair, and weekday month‑end processing. They do not establish coverage of Saturday month‑end sessions, the specific service‑level times for exception clearance, or the exact threshold for escalation beyond the £10,000 figure.
